description: Godot 4.7 Control-node API for menus and HUDs: anchors, Containers, Theme and StyleBox, focus neighbours and stretch settings, with a headless layout check. Use when Godot UI overlaps or drifts on resize, buttons ignore the gamepad, or an invisible panel swallows clicks. Not for engine-neutral UI rules (`game-ui-ux`; load both) or rebinding (`input-systems`).
